title: Purple Mage Fighter
description: A full-body illustration of a young female warrior with white hair in buns and a spiky purple halo. She wears a white and purple martial arts outfit with armored plates, stands in a dynamic combat pose, and casts glowing purple magical energy from both hands.
prompt: A young East Asian female warrior with pale lavender-white hair styled in two buns and long flowing strands, wearing an intricate white and purple traditional martial arts outfit with armored shoulder plates, a wide purple sash, and matching boots. She has a glowing purple spiked halo floating above her head. She stands in a powerful combat stance, casting swirling purple arcane energy from her right hand and a crescent-shaped magic orb from her left hand. Dynamic anime-inspired digital illustration, clean lines, vibrant colors, dark gray background.
